---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug, translation glitch, or site compatibility issue
title: "[BUG] "
labels: ["bug"]
assignees: ""
---

### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Open popup / hover over image / open Studio
3. Trigger translation or action '...'
4. See error or unexpected output

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Screenshots / Sample Images
If applicable, attach screenshots or a sample manga panel showing the issue (OCR miss, text overflow, rendering glitch, etc.).

### Environment
- **Kites Version:** [e.g. 1.3.2]
- **Browser & Version:** [e.g. Chrome 130, Brave 1.70, Edge 130]
- **Operating System:** [e.g. macOS 15 Sequoia, Windows 11, Ubuntu 24.04]
- **GPU / Acceleration:** [e.g. WebGPU enabled, Apple M-series, Nvidia RTX 3060, CPU fallback]
- **Active Translation Provider:** [e.g. Community Pool, WebLLM, Cloudflare AI, Custom API]
- **Site / Source:** [e.g. Manga site URL or local image in Studio]

### Additional Context / Logs
Add any other context or console error logs here (from browser DevTools or `chrome://extensions` -> Inspect background page).
